About Organization

National Testing Agency (NTA) is an organization that conducts various exams in India.

NTA is responsible for conducting the CSIR UGC NET exam.

About the Programme

The CSIR UGC NET exam is conducted to determine the eligibility of candidates for the award of Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and for appointment as Lecturer (LS) in Indian universities and colleges.

The exam is conducted twice a year, in June and December.
